-- Versioned persistence contract. Changing these thresholds requires a migration.
-- Live reward tuning belongs to ProgressionBalance, never to saved level thresholds.
local P={Version=2,CurveVersion=1,MaxLevel=55,MaxPrestige=10,MasteryMax=1000}
P.Modes={"arena","ctf","get_out","duels"}
P.MaxNumber=2^50
function P.Number(value)
 return type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=0 and value<math.huge and math.min(P.MaxNumber,math.floor(value)) or 0
end
function P.Threshold(level)
 local n=math.clamp(P.Number(level)-1,0,54)
 return 800*n+105*n*(n-1)
end
P.CycleCost=P.Threshold(55)
function P.Level(xp,phase)
 xp=P.Number(xp)
 if phase=="legend" then return math.floor(xp/12000)+1 end
 if phase=="mastery" and xp>=P.CycleCost then return math.min(1000,55+math.floor((xp-P.CycleCost)/12000)) end
 local low,high=1,55
 while low<high do local mid=math.ceil((low+high)/2) if P.Threshold(mid)<=xp then low=mid else high=mid-1 end end
 return low
end
function P.Cap(phase)
 if phase=="legend" then return P.MaxNumber end
 return phase=="mastery" and P.CycleCost+945*12000 or P.CycleCost
end
local function copy(value)
 if type(value)~="table" then return value end
 local result={} for k,v in value do result[k]=copy(v) end return result
end
P.Copy=copy
function P.New()
 local p={schemaVersion=2,curveVersion=1,revision=0,lifetimeXP=0,phase="normal",prestige=0,cycleXP=0,stats={},weapons={},tokens={},permanent={},cosmetics={cards={default=true},frames={default=true},titles={default=true},emblems={default=true}},identity={card="default",frame="default",title="default",emblem="default"},transitions=0}
 for _,mode in P.Modes do p.tokens[mode]=0 p.permanent[mode]={} end
 return p
end
function P.Transition(p)
 if p.phase=="legend" or p.cycleXP<P.Cap(p.phase) then return false,"Alcance o limite da etapa." end
 if p.phase=="mastery" then p.phase="legend"
 elseif p.prestige<10 then p.prestige+=1
 else p.phase="mastery" end
 p.cycleXP=0 p.transitions+=1
 for _,mode in P.Modes do p.tokens[mode]+=1 end
 -- Unlocks are derived from cycle level. Legend retains completed account unlocks.
 p.accountUnlocked=p.phase=="legend"
 return true
end
function P.Migrate(old)
 if old==nil then return P.New() end
 if type(old)~="table" then return nil,"Perfil inválido; origem preservada." end
 if old.schemaVersion~=nil then
  if old.schemaVersion~=2 or old.curveVersion~=1 then return nil,"Versão de perfil incompatível." end
  if not table.find({"normal","mastery","legend"},old.phase) or type(old.stats)~="table" or type(old.weapons)~="table" or type(old.tokens)~="table" or type(old.permanent)~="table" or type(old.cosmetics)~="table" or type(old.identity)~="table" then return nil,"Estrutura de perfil inválida." end
  for _,mode in P.Modes do if type(old.tokens[mode])~="number" or type(old.permanent[mode])~="table" then return nil,"Inventário incompleto." end end
  for _,key in {"revision","lifetimeXP","prestige","cycleXP","transitions"} do if type(old[key])~="number" or old[key]~=P.Number(old[key]) then return nil,"Progresso inválido." end end
  if old.prestige>10 or old.cycleXP>P.Cap(old.phase) then return nil,"Etapa inválida." end
  return copy(old)
 end
 local p=P.New()
 for key,value in old do if type(key)=="string" and type(value)=="number" then p.stats[key]=P.Number(value) end end
 p.lifetimeXP=P.Number(old.XP)
 local remaining=p.lifetimeXP
 -- At an exact boundary leave the voluntary transition available, not consumed.
 while p.phase~="legend" and remaining>P.Cap(p.phase) do
  local cost=P.Cap(p.phase) remaining-=cost p.cycleXP=cost P.Transition(p)
 end
 p.cycleXP=remaining p.migratedFrom=1
 return p
end
function P.Award(p,amounts,mode,weaponId,weaponXP)
 for key,value in amounts do
  local n=P.Number(value)
  p.stats[key]=math.min(P.MaxNumber,P.Number(p.stats[key])+n)
  if table.find(P.Modes,mode) then local k=mode.."_"..key p.stats[k]=math.min(P.MaxNumber,P.Number(p.stats[k])+n) end
 end
 local xp=P.Number(amounts.XP)
 p.lifetimeXP=math.min(P.MaxNumber,p.lifetimeXP+xp)
 p.cycleXP=math.min(P.Cap(p.phase),p.cycleXP+xp)
 if type(weaponId)=="string" and #weaponId<=80 then p.weapons[weaponId]=math.min(P.MaxNumber,P.Number(p.weapons[weaponId])+P.Number(weaponXP)) end
end
function P.WeaponLevel(xp) return math.min(55,math.floor(math.sqrt(P.Number(xp)/200))+1) end
function P.Unlock(p,mode,item)
 if not table.find(P.Modes,mode) or type(item)~="string" then return false,"Item inválido." end
 if p.permanent[mode][item] then return false,"Item já permanente." end
 if p.tokens[mode]<1 then return false,"Sem token nesta modalidade." end
 p.tokens[mode]-=1 p.permanent[mode][item]=true return true
end
function P.EquipIdentity(p,slot,id)
 local categories={card="cards",frame="frames",title="titles",emblem="emblems"}
 local category=categories[slot]
 if not category or type(id)~="string" or not p.cosmetics[category] or not p.cosmetics[category][id] then return false,"Cosmético não conquistado." end
 p.identity[slot]=id return true
end
function P.Public(p,userId,name)
 return {userId=userId,name=name,phase=p.phase,prestige=p.prestige,level=P.Level(p.cycleXP,p.phase),identity=copy(p.identity),revision=p.revision}
end
return P

local function memory()
 local data={} local store={}
 function store:GetAsync(k) return P.Copy(data[k]) end
 function store:UpdateAsync(k,fn) local v=fn(P.Copy(data[k])) if v then data[k]=P.Copy(v) end return P.Copy(v) end

end

  local dss=game:GetService("DataStoreService")

 local p=r.profile

 player:SetAttribute("CareerSaveState",r.error or (Run:IsStudio() and "StudioSessionOnly" or r.pending and "RetryPending" or "Saved"))
 if not p then return end

 Cosmetics.Grant(r.profile)
 table.clear(r.queue)
end

 local r=records[player]
 if r then return r.profile,r.error end
 r={queue={},saving=false,pending=false} records[player]=r
 local p,err=repository():Open(player.UserId)
 if not player.Parent then if p then repository():Close(player.UserId) end records[player]=nil return nil,"Jogador saiu." end

 r.profile=p r.error=err publish(player,r) return p,err
end

 local r=records[player] if not r or not r.profile or r.error then return false end
 if r.saving or r.pending then table.insert(r.queue,{amounts=P.Copy(amounts),mode=mode,weapon=weapon,weaponXP=weaponXP})

end

 local r=records[player] if not r or not r.profile or r.error then return false,"Perfil indisponível." end
 if r.saving then return false,"Gravação em andamento." end
 r.saving=true
 local ok,result=repository():Commit(player.UserId,r.profile)
 r.saving=false r.pending=not ok
 if ok then r.profile=P.Copy(result) r.dirty=#r.queue>0 applyAwards(r) end

function Repository.new(store,legacy,owner,clock)

end
local function key(id) return "u"..tostring(id) end

 if self.leases[id] then return nil,"Perfil já aberto nesta sessão." end

 if not ok then return nil,"Não foi possível ler o perfil." end
 local origin
 if existing==nil then
  local read,data=pcall(function() return self.legacy:GetAsync(key(id)) end)
  if not read then return nil,"Histórico indisponível; migração cancelada." end
  local migrated,why=Policy.Migrate(data) if not migrated then return nil,why end origin=migrated
 end
 local rejection
 local success,saved=pcall(function()
  return self.store:UpdateAsync(key(id),function(current)
   rejection=nil
   if current~=nil and type(current)~="table" then rejection="Registro inválido." return nil end
   if current and (type(current.profile)~="table" or type(current.sequence)~="number") then rejection="Registro incompleto; origem preservada." return nil end
   local lease=current and current.lease
   if lease and lease.owner~=self.owner and lease.expires>self.clock() then rejection="Perfil ativo em outro servidor." return nil end
   local p,why=Policy.Migrate(current and current.profile or origin)
   if not p then rejection=why return nil end
   return {profile=p,lease={owner=self.owner,expires=self.clock()+self.leaseSeconds},sequence=current and current.sequence or 0}
  end)
 end)
 if not success or rejection or not saved then return nil,rejection or "Não foi possível reservar o perfil." end

end
function Repository:Commit(id,profile)
 local session=self.leases[id] if not session then return false,"Perfil sem sessão." end

 -- Callers serialize mutations until Commit confirms. Retain uncertain writes.
 if session.pending then clean=Policy.Copy(session.pending) else session.pending=Policy.Copy(clean) end

 clean.revision=sequence
 local rejection
 local ok,saved=pcall(function()
  return self.store:UpdateAsync(key(id),function(current)
   rejection=nil
   if not current or not current.lease or current.lease.owner~=self.owner or current.lease.expires<=self.clock() then rejection="Sessão expirada; escrita recusada." return nil end
   -- Retrying an uncertain write confirms exactly the same sequence.
   if current.sequence==sequence then return current end
   if current.sequence~=session.sequence then rejection="Conflito de revisão." return nil end
   return {profile=clean,sequence=sequence,lease={owner=self.owner,expires=self.clock()+self.leaseSeconds}}
  end)
 end)
 if not ok or rejection or not saved then return false,rejection or "Gravação pendente." end
 session.sequence=saved.sequence session.profile=Policy.Copy(saved.profile) session.pending=nil

end

 local session=self.leases[id] if not session then return false end
 local accepted=false
 local ok=pcall(function() self.store:UpdateAsync(key(id),function(current)
  accepted=false
  if not current or not current.lease or current.lease.owner~=self.owner or current.lease.expires<=self.clock() then return nil end
  current.lease.expires=self.clock()+self.leaseSeconds accepted=true return current
 end) end)

end

  accepted=false
  if not current or not current.lease or current.lease.owner~=self.owner then return nil end
  current.lease=nil accepted=true return current
 end) end)
 if ok and accepted then self.leases[id]=nil return true end
 return false
end
